content.text:
Built **Snap Sort**, a responsive 2D game in `index.html`. Tap left for a woman or right for a man; one wrong choice ends the run. It includes randomized character appearances and outfits, score and streak tracking, saved best score, sound toggle, and keyboard controls.

I interpreted the clothing-change idea as a quick style scan, keeping every character fully clothed and adult. Checked the game at a phone-sized viewport.
